integrity: The proof is self-contained; standard Faulhaber identity and published special-index valuations are acknowledged. Finite checker supports but does not replace the infinite branch-isometry proof. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Complete local image, fibers, period and Haar measure at 2 only for the fifth-power partial sum. No claim about odd primes, higher odd exponents, global simultaneous representability, or independently certified originality.
title: Exact dyadic image, fibers, and periods of consecutive fifth-power sums
